m1.typescript: m1 a verified customer can look up an order and be refunded within the limit

e1.typescript: e1 a refund before identity is verified is blocked in code and never reaches the backend

e2.typescript: e2 an order that belongs to someone else is neither shown nor refundable

e3.typescript: e3 a refund is checked against the order its amount and what is left

e4.typescript: e4 a refund over the limit is not executed and becomes a structured hand off

e5.typescript: e5 a failed check does not unlock anything and three in a row lock the desk

e6.typescript: e6 unknown tools and backend errors are reported and the hand off lists every block

wrong-identity-unchecked.defect: lets any call but verification through without a verified customer

wrong-ownership-unchecked.defect: remembers and shows an order that belongs to another customer

wrong-over-limit-executes.defect: runs a refund above the limit instead of handing it to a person

wrong-failure-unlocks.defect: keeps the earlier verified customer after a failed check

wrong-no-lockout.defect: never locks the desk after repeated failed checks

wrong-exceeds-ignored.defect: refunds more than what is left on the order

wrong-zero-amount-ok.defect: accepts a refund of zero cents

wrong-handoff-no-blocks.defect: leaves the refusals out of the hand-off
